lo:g10m12s1-1-3.why: orchestrator/AI ruling (G1 auto-pass, answer 37c; not a human stamp): section 12.1 never teaches calculating an unknown angle in a parallelogram as a skill of its own. Its teaching text is proving that a quadrilateral is a parallelogram (b04026, WE1) and the parallelogram's properties (the opposite-angles video note b04029; summary b04049-b04052). The objective's only valid evidence is the summary line 'Both pairs of opposite angles are equal' (b04051), a property lo:g10m12s1-1-2 already carries; the evidence check rejected both exercise quotes ('Find the value of y', 'Determine the value of x') as not showing the skill, and there is no worked example. Same precedent as chapters 1, 5 and 7 (an objective the book never demonstrates is dropped, its items placed on the objective whose taught skill they apply). Exercise-only objectives policy is open with Samuel.
